svg.title: Anatomy of a wall
svg.desc: An exploded view of a fresco wall in five layers, from the bottom: the masonry (muro); rough plaster (arriccio); the red drawing (sinopia), floating on its own; the fine plaster laid in daily patches (intonaco, giornate); and the painting (affresco). Each layer is named on the left with what it is in the workshop.
svg.text: as the lime sets, it becomes the wall
fine plaster, laid fresh each day:
the full-size drawing in red earth,
made where the work will stand
